children: Chilean Cobalt entered into an option to acquire mining concessions in northern Chile for $27.5 million in scheduled installments, with sellers also entitled to a 1.5% royalty. Separately, the company amended its NeoRe Project earn-in and option agreement, extending the deadline to decide whether to pursue an acquisition to March 31, 2027. The amendment clarifies tranche-three funding treatment and the shares contemplated as acquisition consideration.
